europe_now.title: EU Budget Negotiations Face Crisis After Summit Walkout
europe_now.summary: EU leaders concluded a Brussels summit without securing a budget deal after a walkout during discussions led by Antonio Costa. The impasse leaves negotiators with only a month to salvage an agreement ahead of the upcoming Christmas summit.

europe_now.title: Pablo Hernández de Cos Selected as Next ECB President
europe_now.summary: Spanish economist Pablo Hernández de Cos has been chosen to succeed Christine Lagarde as the next president of the European Central Bank. The transition marks a significant leadership shift for the central banking institution.

top_stories.title: EU Budget Impasse
top_stories.summary: European Union leaders left Brussels without an agreement on the bloc's budget following a summit walkout. Negotiators now face a tight one-month deadline to resolve divisions before the Christmas summit.

top_stories.title: European Central Bank Leadership
top_stories.summary: Spanish economist Pablo Hernández de Cos has been designated to take over the presidency of the European Central Bank. He is slated to succeed the current head, Christine Lagarde.
